name: Microsoft Mesh
summary:
Important Update: Transition to Immersive Events in Teams

Starting December 1, 2025, Microsoft will retire the following experiences: Microsoft Mesh apps on PC and Quest, Mesh on web, and immersive space (3D) view in Teams meetings.
 
Going forward, Microsoft plans to focus on the development of immersive events in Microsoft Teams, an interactive, engaging virtual event experience with customizable 3D environments.
